0.long_answer: The condition described refers to pericarditis, which is inflammation of the fibrous sac surrounding the heart. In most cases, especially in the developed world, this inflammation is believed to be due to a viral infection. Viruses such as coxsackievirus and others are commonly linked to the development of this condition. Even though in some cases the cause is unknown (referred to as idiopathic pericarditis), clinical evidence suggests that viral infections account for the majority of pericarditis cases.
